nodes.title: feat(e2e): run defined cold scenarios with complete results

description:
An operator selects reusable cold scenarios for one exact commit and receives a complete per-flow result and aggregate report after every runnable flow finishes.

## Scope

* In: scenario definitions, filtering, serial execution through the existing disposable cold constructor, per-attempt records, Pest integration, aggregate reporting, and on-demand command guidance.
* Out: snapshot scenarios, parallel workers, nightly or pull-request triggers, affected-flow selection, new product behavior, feature-proof gates, and snapshot replacement or promotion.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The command resolves an exact candidate and an optional scenario filter, and rejects unknown IDs, duplicate IDs, invalid recipes, missing action deadlines, or invalid declared inputs before Incus mutation. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Feature/Commands/ScenarioWrapperTest.php` and `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ScenarioDefinitionTest.php`.
- [ ] Each result identifies the candidate, run, attempt, lane, normalized recipe and definition fingerprints, declared inputs, phase timing, action outcomes, verification, diagnostics, and cleanup; editing a declared definition or input invalidates its fingerprint. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ScenarioResultTest.php`.
- [ ] Two selected cold flows construct separate exact inventories from the recorded unchanged generic image; failure at a required step stops that flow, attempts its cleanup, and still runs the other flow. Proof: the existing `apps/e2e/tests/Scenario/ColdTopologyAcceptanceTest.php` extended with the dedicated Incus harness acceptance `cold-scenario-suite`.
- [ ] JSON and standard Pest reports distinguish passed, failed, blocked by an unavailable required checkpoint, and infrastructure-error outcomes; the process returns nonzero after writing the complete aggregate when any selected flow is not passed. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Feature/Commands/ScenarioWrapperTest.php`.
- [ ] Success, action failure, reporting failure, and interrupted construction attempt exact owned cleanup; cleanup failure retains both the original outcome and the remaining exact resources with a supported recovery action, and never deletes unrelated resources. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/ColdTopologyConstructorTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `cold-scenario-suite-cleanup`.
- [ ] Running the command leaves the promoted generation and manifest unchanged and creates no issue-proof or promotion receipt; ordinary acquisition, proof, review, and merge do not invoke it. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Feature/Commands/ScenarioWrapperTest.php` and Incus harness acceptance `cold-scenario-suite`.
- [ ] Maintained scenario guidance describes the command, filters, result meanings, and exact cleanup; generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Harness checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/e2e && composer check`.
title: Run defined cold scenarios with complete results
